coreMaintenance.headline: Stator Core Rehabilitation & Magnetic Integrity
coreMaintenance.lead: Damaged stator laminations cause severe hot spots and catastrophic motor failure. Tarfa's dedicated core workshop repairs and re-insulates laminations without requiring complete core replacement.

mosaic.title: Core Testing & Flux Diagnostics
mosaic.description: Loop flux testing and thermal scan to pinpoint interlaminar insulation breakdown and iron loss hot spots.

mosaic.title: Core Cleaning & Re-Varnishing
mosaic.description: Removal of carbonized varnish, chemical cleansing of laminations, and application of high-dielectric baking varnish.

mosaic.title: Core Spot Welding
mosaic.description: Precision localized spot welding to secure loosened stator teeth and eliminate mechanical vibration during operation.

process.headline: 7-Stage Industrial Refurbishment Lifecycle
process.note: Standard workshop protocol for rewinding and overhauls. Custom testing regimens available upon request.
process.clientNote: Client confirmation required for project-specific inspection criteria.

steps.title: Receive & Inspect
steps.desc: Incoming physical inspection, nameplate recording, and initial mechanical fault diagnosis.

steps.title: Dismantle & Test
steps.desc: Systematic mechanical teardown, static insulation tests, and core flux assessment.

steps.title: Rewind & Repair
steps.desc: Precision round or strip wire winding, slot insulation insertion, and wedge sealing.

steps.title: Varnish & Bake
steps.desc: Vacuum pressure impregnation / dip varnishing followed by temperature-controlled oven curing.

steps.title: Balance & Reassemble
steps.desc: Dynamic balancing of main rotors on precision balancing machine and mechanical reassembly.

steps.title: Final Testing
steps.desc: Full no-load running test, vibration analysis, megger test, and phase balance verification.

steps.title: Handover & Dispatch
steps.desc: Protective painting, terminal box sealing, and comprehensive test documentation report.
